narration: For {identical_months} month the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month}, a week short of payday, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. The ghost's money touched bottom in month {ghost_lowest_month}. In month {layoff_month} the layoff came for both of you, and the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. In how its days felt, the ghost finished {life_gap}.
